note: Wanted requests shown on the Rare Finds page. The site owner adds entries to the 'wanted' list; it starts empty. Each entry: {"make": "Lancia", "model": "Delta Integrale", "years": [1991, 1994], "region": "Europe", "note": "Evo II preferred"}. make is required; model, years, region and note are optional. A card is flagged when its make matches and the model words all appear in its title or model name, its year is in range, and its region matches.
